parse.title: Jackal (Alpha)
parse.text:
Overview

Jackal (Alpha) is a MythicalMythical unit. He is only obtainable by evolving Jackal. He is also the boss of stage 6 of Spirit World as The Wolf.

Evolving

Jackal (Alpha) can be evolved from Jackal with the following materials:

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Passive Ability: Los Lobos

Jackal (Alpha) summons a Spirit Wolf with 1 HP that deals 1/3 (33.34%) of Jackal (Alpha)'s current damage upon death, which it hits anyone within the explosion radius. The explosion even hits flying enemies.

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.
